test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Abraham can complete a work in 9 days, while Andrew can complete the same work in 6 days. In how many days can they complete the work if they work together?
solution:
Given:

Abraham can complete a work in 9 days, while Andrew can complete the same work in 6 days.

Concept used:

Efficiency = (Total work / Total time taken)

Efficiency = work done in a single day 

Calculation:

Let total work is 18 units ( Lcm of 6 and9 )

The efficiency of Abraham is

⇒ 18 / 6 = 3 unit

Again, the Efficiency of Andrew is,

⇒ 18 / 9 = 2 unit

Total Efficiency,

⇒ 3 + 2 = 5 unit

The number of days required is,

⇒ 18 /5 = 3{3 over 5} days

**∴ The correct option is 2**
